description: Day-to-day test automation — the universal loop with path-based entry. understand → ground → design → generate → execute → heal → audit, plus a coverage node (reachable via the gaps path through ground, or entered directly via the coverage path for a read-only AC diff) and escalate as a terminal outcome.

edges.when: requirement drafted (story status: draft); elements not yet captured
path == write — required elements captured/validated (or ingested from a recording)
path == fix — the failing element has been re-captured
path == gaps — screens mapped against the test inventory
the story + test plan were approved by the user
an approved scenario has no captured locator evidence — capture it, then return to design
files written/edited and `npm run audit` is clean
there are failures that look fixable in-workflow
a failure is a genuine app bug — do not edit the tests
root cause == locator drift — the element must be re-captured
root cause == test/spec bug or flakiness (waits/races) — fix via direct edit or codegen
root cause == app bug or environment — stop and report
a gap report was produced and the user wants analysis only
the user chose to fill the gaps now — continue as a write flow
